decision_question: Does the en-US to fr-FR directed webpage translation package conform to Foundry naming and structure guidance, belong in the Universal family, and have safe enough controls for an analytical structural-integrity handoff?
acceptance_criteria: The portable name matches the package directory and all Foundry path and line limits.
The package uses the OKHP3 frontmatter, header, footer, progressive disclosure, scoped helpers, and risk-based evaluations.
The one-way en-US to fr-FR boundary and draft-only publication boundary fail safely.
A malformed, empty, missing, or wrong-pair supporting control cannot pass deterministic validation.
The handoff does not claim native French quality, owner-voice fidelity, live automation, or production readiness without live evidence.

shared_model_or_source_limits: All analytical role findings were prepared in one Codex session and are correlated self-review, not independent release evidence.
No external French-language reviewer, live website fixture, or protected translation-quality holdout was available.

material_findings.claim: Foundry naming, brand, package, and deterministic-validation requirements are met by the frozen v0.3.0 artifact.
material_findings.consequence: A structural defect could make the package nonportable or bypass its control contract.
material_findings.next_test: Re-run the recorded validators after each material change.

material_findings.claim: No live translation-quality result exists for v0.3.0.
material_findings.consequence: A structural result could be mistaken for language-quality evidence.
material_findings.next_test: Run an external French-language holdout before any quality or production claim.

assumptions: Local file evidence remains unchanged after review.
release_conditions: Keep all quality claims bounded to analytical structural integrity.
initial_reviews.notes: The evidence supports a package-structure finding only.

material_findings.claim: A dedicated directed pair, source voice profile, pair dictionary, singular target manifest, and review state directly address the requested consistency controls.
material_findings.consequence: A generic multilingual package would weaken terminology and output consistency.
material_findings.next_test: Exercise the package on an owned en-US page through the separately controlled holdout.

material_findings.claim: Universal is the best current family placement.
material_findings.consequence: A premature new family would have no shared family-level contract beyond one package.
material_findings.next_test: Create a localization family only when several pair packages require shared routing and standards.

assumptions: The future sibling packages will remain pair-specific rather than becoming hidden modes.
release_conditions: Use a new pair package and dictionary for each selected Spanish or German locale.
initial_reviews.notes: The package meets the stated design objective, not an unmeasured language-quality objective.

material_findings.claim: The helpers are dependency-free and read-only, reject path traversal in supporting controls, and never publish or translate content.
material_findings.consequence: A helper with hidden writes or permissive control paths could alter a site or consume unintended data.
material_findings.next_test: Preserve no-write and control-path regression cases if helper inputs change.

material_findings.claim: The dictionary and voice profile are now structurally required controls rather than merely present files.
material_findings.consequence: Empty or wrong-pair controls could otherwise pass and undermine the directed-pair boundary.
material_findings.next_test: Add validation for any future control field that becomes required by the SKILL.md contract.

assumptions: A host agent will respect the SKILL.md publication boundary.
release_conditions: Do not add a publishing adapter without separate explicit authorization and site-specific controls.
initial_reviews.notes: The package is portable for drafting and deterministic checking, with no native-language certification.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: The structural suite could pass a mistranslation, an unnatural France French phrase, or loss of the owner's voice.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Attempt an external French-language review of unseen owned source and target pages.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Not run because no external review or protected holdout was available. The limitation survives.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: A wrong-pair, empty, malformed, or missing control file could pass validation and undermine consistency.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Run fixtures with missing controls, an incomplete voice profile, and an empty or fr-CA dictionary.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Falsified for the tested cases: the v0.3.0 validator and seven-test suite reject them.

falsification_hypotheses.hypothesis: The package could silently publish a target page through its helpers.
falsification_hypotheses.test: Inspect helper code and run the no-write planner fixture.
falsification_hypotheses.result: Falsified for the packaged helpers: they report writes_performed false and contain no publication path.

test_results: D-02 and D-03 were rejected only for the recorded deterministic fixtures and source inspection.

unresolved_items: No live or protected holdout establishes French accuracy, naturalness, or owner-voice preservation.
No native-speaker review is available to change a result to approved translation quality.
No host-specific automation implementation has been evaluated.
negotiator.rationale: The evidence supports Universal placement and controlled structural handoff, but not a language-quality or production-readiness claim.

limitations: This is a correlated analytical review, not independent multi-agent evidence.
The package is not certified for native French quality, legal text accuracy, live automation, or publication.
The seed dictionary is not native-reviewed and must not override owner-approved terminology.
follow_up: Use the package with a real owned en-US page and preserve the resulting source, target, and translation record.
Obtain an external French-language review method or protected holdout before making quality claims.
Reassess a dedicated localization family only after multiple directed pair packages share a durable family-level contract.
